what: The grids, targets and non-regression margins for issue #257's resonance-keyed cutoff correction, COMMITTED BEFORE ANY CANDIDATE WAS FITTED OR MEASURED. model/res_tuning.py reads this file and refuses to evaluate if it is missing or dirty in git, so a target cannot be moved after its result is seen without that move being a visible commit.
baseline: the shipped filter: voice_fx.make_g_rom() (CUT_TRIM * fcr law, edge-sampled 129 entries), voice_fx.make_k_rom(), no resonance correction -- reference_rigs.OurLadder('ours')

fit.role: the resonance correction's table entries are fitted here and nowhere else
fit.res: the table's own knots, res = 1 + i/(entries-1), i >= 1; entry 0 (res = 1.0, the onset) is fixed at unity, not fitted

select.role: the table size and the tuning-law degree are chosen on this grid (docs/sensitivity/res-cut-correction-*.json). Historical: these are model/ladder_headroom.py's REPORT_CUTS x REPORT_RES, the grid issue #237's 105 cents was measured on

validate.role: UNTOUCHED. Never used to fit or select. Intermediate resonances and cutoffs absent from both grids above, plus the low and high cutoff endpoints (30 Hz is voice_fx.CUT_MIN; 16 kHz is above anything fitted)

metrics.offset_cents: 1200*log2(f_osc / commanded) of the fixed-point filter's sustained free ring, per (cut, res) point
metrics.mean_offset_travel_cents: max minus min, over the grid's resonances, of the across-cutoff mean of offset_cents -- issue #237's travel, generalised from two resonances to every resonance on the grid
metrics.per_cut_travel_cents: for each cutoff, max minus min of offset_cents over the grid's resonances; reported per cutoff, the worst is the gated number
metrics.worst_abs_cents: max |offset_cents| over every point of the grid
metrics.mean_abs_cents: mean |offset_cents| over every point of the grid

non_regression.N3_onset: at every validation cutoff: res = onset_below_res does NOT sustain a ring and res = onset_above_res does, for baseline and candidate alike. A below-onset point is classified, never given a frequency
non_regression.why: a travel reduction bought by moving the whole family further out of tune does not pass: N1 bounds the worst point, N2 forbids the average point getting worse at all, N3 keeps DR 0006's 'res = 1 is the onset everywhere' property

estimator.qualified_on: synthetic signals whose frequency is known by construction (model/res_tuning.py qualify_estimator), never on the filter
refuses: zero-crossing and spectral-peak estimates disagreeing by more than 0.5 %
